name: FWB Work Report（工人报工表）脚本
script:
# ========== FWB Work Report (Before Save) ==========

# 0. 计费方式：默认按“计件”处理旧单据
#    注意：在 Server Script 里不要用 hasattr / getattr
wage_type = doc.wage_type or "计件"

# 1. 强制类型转换 (处理 Int 和 None)
# qty 是 Int，其他可能是 Float，这里统一转为 Float 计算
qty = frappe.utils.flt(doc.qty or 0)
defect = frappe.utils.flt(doc.defect_qty or 0)
recovered = frappe.utils.flt(doc.recovered_qty or 0)

# 2. 计算有效数量 (核心公式)
# 逻辑：报工总数 - 质检扣除 + 返工回补
doc.valid_qty = qty - defect + recovered

# ========== A. 计时模式：只按工时 & 时薪算金额 ==========
if wage_type == "计时":
    # 1) 计时金额：duration 存的是秒
    duration_sec = frappe.utils.flt(doc.duration or 0)
    hours = duration_sec / 3600.0

    hourly_rate = frappe.utils.flt(doc.hourly_rate or 0)
    doc.total_amount = hours * hourly_rate

    # 2) 计时单不参与 BOM 计件单价的读取 & 反写
    #    也不强制设置 custom_piece_rate，保持前端隐藏状态即可

else:
    # ========== B. 计件模式：保持你原来的逻辑 ==========
    # 3. 自动获取/更新单价
    bom_no = frappe.db.get_value("Work Order", doc.work_order, "bom_no") if doc.work_order else None
    rate = 0.0
    bom_op_name = None

    if bom_no:
        filters = {"parent": bom_no}
        if doc.workstation:
            filters["workstation"] = doc.workstation

        op = frappe.get_all(
            "BOM Operation",
            filters=filters,
            fields=["name", "custom_piece_rate"],
            limit=1,
            ignore_permissions=True
        )

        if op:
            bom_op_name = op[0].name
            rate = frappe.utils.flt(op[0].custom_piece_rate)

    # 决定使用哪个单价
    if rate > 0:
        # BOM 有单价，强制使用 BOM 单价
        doc.custom_piece_rate = rate
    else:
        # BOM 没单价，使用表单里的值，并反写回 BOM
        rate = frappe.utils.flt(doc.custom_piece_rate or 0)
        if bom_op_name and rate > 0:
            frappe.db.set_value("BOM Operation", bom_op_name, "custom_piece_rate", rate)

    # 4. 计算总金额（计件逻辑）
    if doc.rework_type == "有偿返工":
        # 有偿返工：按报工数 * 返工单价
        doc.total_amount = qty * frappe.utils.flt(doc.rework_rate or 0)
    else:
        # 正常生产/无偿返工：按【有效数量】 * 【计件单价】
        doc.total_amount = doc.valid_qty * rate

# 5. 记录时间 (用于下拉框显示)
if not doc.get("created_at"):
    doc.created_at = frappe.utils.now_datetime()

doc.report_date = frappe.utils.getdate(doc.created_at)

name: Rework Record
script:
# ========== Rework Record (After Submit) ==========
# 逻辑：直接计算并更新 FWB Work Report 的所有数据

if doc.from_work_report:
    # 1. 获取源单据
    target = frappe.get_doc("FWB Work Report", doc.from_work_report)
    is_changed = False
    
    action = (doc.rework_action or "").strip()
    
    # 2. 更新扣除/回补数量
    if action == "次品扣除" and doc.defective_qty > 0:
        target.defect_qty = frappe.utils.flt(target.defect_qty) + doc.defective_qty
        is_changed = True
            
    elif action == "良品回补" and doc.reworked_qty > 0:
        target.recovered_qty = frappe.utils.flt(target.recovered_qty) + doc.reworked_qty
        is_changed = True
            
    if is_changed:
        # 3. 在此处直接计算有效数量
        qty = frappe.utils.flt(target.qty)
        defect = frappe.utils.flt(target.defect_qty)
        recovered = frappe.utils.flt(target.recovered_qty)
        
        # 公式：报工 - 扣除 + 回补
        target.valid_qty = qty - defect + recovered
        
        # 4. 重算总金额（⚠ 仅对“非计时单”生效）
        #    计时单的 total_amount = duration * hourly_rate，不受质检影响
        wage_type = target.wage_type or "计件"
        
        if wage_type != "计时":
            # 保持你之前的计件逻辑：按有效数量 * 计件单价
            if target.custom_piece_rate:
                target.total_amount = target.valid_qty * target.custom_piece_rate
        
        # 5. 强制保存
        target.flags.ignore_validate_update_after_submit = True
        target.save(ignore_permissions=True)
        
        frappe.msgprint(
            f"✅ 已同步更新生产报工单：\n质检扣除: {target.defect_qty}\n返工回补: {target.recovered_qty}\n有效数量: {target.valid_qty}"
        )
        
    # 6. 无论本次是否扣数 / 回补，都要维护“已质检总数”
    #    规则：同一个 from_work_report 下，所有【已提交】Rework Record 的 quality_inspected 之和
    total_quality_inspected = frappe.db.sql(
        """
        SELECT SUM(IFNULL(quality_inspected, 0))
        FROM `tabRework Record`
        WHERE from_work_report = %s
          AND docstatus = 1
        """,
        (doc.from_work_report,),
    )[0][0] or 0

    # 6.1 当前这张单据记录一个“快照值”
    frappe.db.set_value(
        "Rework Record",
        doc.name,
        "total_quality_inspected",
        total_quality_inspected,
    )

    # 6.2 同步更新同一个报工号下其他已提交的 Rework Record
    other_names = frappe.db.get_all(
        "Rework Record",
        filters={
            "from_work_report": doc.from_work_report,
            "docstatus": 1,
            "name": ["!=", doc.name],
        },
        pluck="name",
    )
    for name in other_names:
        frappe.db.set_value(
            "Rework Record",
            name,
            "total_quality_inspected",
            total_quality_inspected,
        )

script:
# 脚本名称: get_piece_rate
# 脚本类型: API

work_order = frappe.form_dict.get("work_order")
workstation = frappe.form_dict.get("workstation")
user_id = frappe.session.user

# 初始化返回，完全保持旧版结构
response_data = {
    "employee": None, "employee_name": None, "workstation": None,       
    "valid_workstations": [], "rate": 0.0, "rate_from_bom": False,    
    "product_name": "", "routing_action": "STAY", "debug_msg": "",
    "bom_no": ""
}

# 1. 身份识别 (完全沿用你的旧代码)
if user_id != "Administrator":
    emp = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", {"user_id": user_id}, ["name", "employee_name"], as_dict=True)
    if emp:
        response_data["employee"] = emp.name
        response_data["employee_name"] = emp.employee_name
        emp_ops = frappe.get_all("Employee Operation", filters={"parent": emp.name}, fields=["workstation"], ignore_permissions=True)
        response_data["valid_workstations"] = [str(row.workstation).strip() for row in emp_ops if row.workstation]
        
        qc_count = 0
        pack_count = 0
        prod_count = 0
        
        qc_kws = ["质检", "QC", "Quality", "检测", "检验"]
        pack_kws = ["打包", "Packing", "包装", "发货"]

        for ws in response_data["valid_workstations"]:
            if any(k in ws for k in qc_kws): qc_count += 1
            elif any(k in ws for k in pack_kws): pack_count += 1
            else: prod_count += 1
                
        if qc_count > 0 and prod_count == 0 and pack_count == 0:
            response_data["routing_action"] = "QC"
        elif pack_count > 0 and prod_count == 0 and qc_count == 0:
            response_data["routing_action"] = "PACK"
        elif (qc_count + prod_count + pack_count) > 1 or (qc_count > 0 and prod_count > 0):
            response_data["routing_action"] = "MIXED"
        else:
            response_data["routing_action"] = "PROD"

        if len(response_data["valid_workstations"]) == 1:
            response_data["workstation"] = response_data["valid_workstations"][0]

final_workstation = workstation or response_data["workstation"]

# 2. 查产品与单价 (增强调试逻辑)
if work_order:
    wo_doc = frappe.db.get_value("Work Order", work_order, ["name", "bom_no", "production_item", "item_name"], as_dict=True)
    if wo_doc:
        response_data["bom_no"] = wo_doc.bom_no
        p_name = wo_doc.item_name
        if not p_name and wo_doc.production_item:
            p_name = frappe.db.get_value("Item", wo_doc.production_item, "item_name")
        response_data["product_name"] = p_name or wo_doc.production_item or ""

        if wo_doc.bom_no and final_workstation:
            # 尝试 1：直接精确匹配 (旧逻辑)
            ops = frappe.get_all("BOM Operation", 
                filters={"parent": wo_doc.bom_no, "workstation": final_workstation}, 
                fields=["custom_piece_rate"], ignore_permissions=True, limit=1
            )
            
            if ops:
                rate_val = frappe.utils.flt(ops[0].get("custom_piece_rate"))
                response_data["rate"] = rate_val
                response_data["rate_from_bom"] = (rate_val > 0)
                response_data["debug_msg"] = "匹配成功"
            else:
                # 尝试 2：如果匹配失败，列出该 BOM 下所有的工作站，让你看看为什么对不上
                all_ops = frappe.get_all("BOM Operation", 
                    filters={"parent": wo_doc.bom_no}, 
                    fields=["workstation", "workstation_type", "custom_piece_rate"]
                )
                
                debug_info = []
                for op in all_ops:
                    w = op.workstation or "无"
                    wt = op.workstation_type or "无"
                    r = op.custom_piece_rate or 0
                    debug_info.append(f"{w}/{wt}({r})")
                
                response_data["debug_msg"] = f"匹配失败。目标[{final_workstation}] vs BOM列表: " + ", ".join(debug_info)

frappe.response["message"] = response_data

script:
# 脚本类型: DocType Event
# 文档类型: FWB Work Report
# 事件: After Submit (提交后)

# 目的：如果报工时填入了单价，且BOM中原本没有单价，则反向更新BOM
if doc.work_order and doc.custom_piece_rate > 0:
    # 1. 找到关联的 BOM
    wo_bom = frappe.db.get_value("Work Order", doc.work_order, "bom_no")
    
    if wo_bom:
        # 2. 找到 BOM 里对应此工作站的行
        # 我们需要找到 parent = BOM号 且 workstation = 当前工作站 的那一行
        bom_op_name = frappe.db.get_value("BOM Operation", {
            "parent": wo_bom,
            "workstation": doc.workstation
        }, "name")
        
        if bom_op_name:
            # 3. 检查 BOM 里现在的价格
            current_bom_rate = frappe.db.get_value("BOM Operation", bom_op_name, "custom_piece_rate")
            
            # 4. 只有当 BOM 里价格为空或为0时，才执行更新 (避免覆盖已有的标准价)
            # 【修复点】：使用 frappe.utils.flt 代替 flt
            if not current_bom_rate or frappe.utils.flt(current_bom_rate) == 0:
                frappe.db.set_value("BOM Operation", bom_op_name, "custom_piece_rate", doc.custom_piece_rate)
                frappe.msgprint(f"已将单价 {doc.custom_piece_rate} 自动更新到 BOM {wo_bom} 的 {doc.workstation} 工序中。")

name: Rework Record On Cancel
script:
# ========== Rework Record (On Cancel) ==========
# 逻辑：作废单据，回滚数据，并强制重算金额（仅计件单）

if doc.from_work_report:
    target_doc = frappe.get_doc("FWB Work Report", doc.from_work_report)
    is_changed = False
    
    action = (doc.rework_action or "").strip()
    
    defective_qty = frappe.utils.flt(doc.defective_qty)
    reworked_qty = frappe.utils.flt(doc.reworked_qty)
    
    if action == "次品扣除":
        if defective_qty > 0:
            current_defect = frappe.utils.flt(target_doc.defect_qty)
            # 减去扣除数（即恢复有效数量）
            target_doc.defect_qty = max(0, current_defect - defective_qty)
            is_changed = True
            
    elif action == "良品回补":
        if reworked_qty > 0:
            current_recovered = frappe.utils.flt(target_doc.recovered_qty)
            # 减去回补数（即减少有效数量）
            target_doc.recovered_qty = max(0, current_recovered - reworked_qty)
            is_changed = True
            
    if is_changed:
        # 1. 重算有效数量（计件 & 计时单都需要）
        qty = frappe.utils.flt(target_doc.qty)
        defect = frappe.utils.flt(target_doc.defect_qty)
        recovered = frappe.utils.flt(target_doc.recovered_qty)
        
        target_doc.valid_qty = qty - defect + recovered
        
        # 2. 重算总金额（⚠ 仅对“非计时单”生效）
        #    计时单的 total_amount = duration * hourly_rate，不受质检影响
        wage_type = target_doc.wage_type or "计件"
        
        if wage_type != "计时":
            # 【核心修复】重算总金额
            if target_doc.rework_type == "有偿返工":
                # 有偿返工：按报工数 * 返工单价
                rework_rate = frappe.utils.flt(target_doc.rework_rate)
                target_doc.total_amount = qty * rework_rate
            else:
                # 正常生产：有效数量 * 计件单价
                rate = frappe.utils.flt(target_doc.custom_piece_rate)
                target_doc.total_amount = target_doc.valid_qty * rate
        
        # 3. 强制保存
        target_doc.flags.ignore_validate_update_after_submit = True
        target_doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)
        
        frappe.msgprint(f"✅ 已回滚生产报工单数据，当前金额：{target_doc.total_amount}")
        
    # 4. 质检单作废后，重算“已质检总数”
    #    注意：这里显式排除当前这张单据 name，避免还把“已取消”的单计入总数
    total_quality_inspected = frappe.db.sql(
        """
        SELECT SUM(IFNULL(quality_inspected, 0))
        FROM `tabRework Record`
        WHERE from_work_report = %s
          AND docstatus = 1
          AND name != %s
        """,
        (doc.from_work_report, doc.name),
    )[0][0] or 0

    # 更新所有仍然“有效（已提交）”的 Rework Record
    remaining_names = frappe.db.get_all(
        "Rework Record",
        filters={"from_work_report": doc.from_work_report, "docstatus": 1},
        pluck="name",
    )
    for name in remaining_names:
        frappe.db.set_value(
            "Rework Record",
            name,
            "total_quality_inspected",
            total_quality_inspected,
        )

# 脚本名称: get_packing_info
# 脚本类型: API

work_order = frappe.form_dict.get("work_order")
user_id = frappe.session.user

response = {
    "total_packed": 0,      
    "order_qty": 0,         
    "first_record": None,   
    "product_name": "",     
    "packer_name": "",
    "packer_id": ""
}

# 1. 获取打包员信息
if user_id and user_id != "Administrator":
    # 尝试获取 Employee
    emp = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", {"user_id": user_id}, ["name", "employee_name"], as_dict=True)
    if emp:
        response["packer_id"] = emp.name
        response["packer_name"] = emp.employee_name

if work_order:
    # 2. 获取工单信息
    wo_doc = frappe.db.get_value("Work Order", work_order, ["qty", "production_item", "item_name"], as_dict=True)
    if wo_doc:
        response["order_qty"] = frappe.utils.flt(wo_doc.qty)
        
        # 产品名逻辑
        p_name = wo_doc.item_name
        if not p_name and wo_doc.production_item:
            p_name = frappe.db.get_value("Item", wo_doc.production_item, "item_name")
        response["product_name"] = p_name or wo_doc.production_item or ""

    # 3. 统计已打包 (防御性查询)
    try:
        packed_data = frappe.db.sql("""
            SELECT IFNULL(SUM(carton_count), 0)
            FROM `tabFWB Packing Record` 
            WHERE work_order = %s AND docstatus = 1
        """, work_order)
        
        response["total_packed"] = frappe.utils.flt(packed_data[0][0]) if packed_data else 0
    except Exception:
        response["total_packed"] = 0

    # 4. 查找历史
    first_entry = frappe.get_all("FWB Packing Record", 
        filters={"work_order": work_order, "docstatus": 1}, 
        fields=["carton_l", "carton_w", "carton_h", "qty_per_carton", "gross_weight"],
        order_by="creation asc",
        limit=1
    )
    
    if first_entry:
        response["first_record"] = first_entry[0]

frappe.response["message"] = response

name: get_employee_stats
script:
# 脚本名称: get_employee_stats
# 脚本类型: API

emp_id = frappe.form_dict.get("employee")
exclude_doc = frappe.form_dict.get("exclude_doc")

response = {
    "history_amt": 0.0,    
    "cur_rate": 0.0,       
    "last_rate": 0.0,      
    "last_month_name": ""  
}

if emp_id:
    # ========= 1. 本月数据：历史金额（排除本单） =========
    base_condition = """
        employee = %s 
        AND docstatus = 1
        AND MONTH(report_date) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE())
        AND YEAR(report_date) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE())
    """
    params = [emp_id]

    # history_amt 要排除当前单（exclude_doc）
    history_condition = base_condition
    history_params = list(params)

    if exclude_doc:
        history_condition += " AND name != %s"
        history_params.append(exclude_doc)

    # 用 total_amount 求本月历史金额（不含当前单）
    sql = f"""
        SELECT 
            SUM(IFNULL(total_amount, 0)),
            IFNULL(SUM(qty), 0),
            IFNULL(SUM(defect_qty), 0)
        FROM `tabFWB Work Report`
        WHERE 
            {history_condition}
    """
    curr_stats = frappe.db.sql(sql, tuple(history_params))
    
    if curr_stats and curr_stats[0]:
        response["history_amt"] = frappe.utils.flt(curr_stats[0][0])

    # ========= 2. 本月“真实次品率”：不排除任何单 =========
    all_stats = frappe.db.sql(f"""
        SELECT 
            IFNULL(SUM(qty), 0),
            IFNULL(SUM(defect_qty), 0)
        FROM `tabFWB Work Report`
        WHERE 
            {base_condition}
    """, tuple(params))
    
    if all_stats and all_stats[0]:
        total_qty = frappe.utils.flt(all_stats[0][0])
        defect_qty = frappe.utils.flt(all_stats[0][1])
        
        if total_qty > 0:
            response["cur_rate"] = (defect_qty / total_qty) * 100.0

    # ========= 3. 上月数据（保持原先逻辑） =========
    last_stats = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT 
            IFNULL(SUM(qty), 0),
            IFNULL(SUM(defect_qty), 0),
            MONTH(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH))
        FROM `tabFWB Work Report`
        WHERE employee = %s 
        AND docstatus = 1
        AND MONTH(report_date) = MONTH(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH))
        AND YEAR(report_date) = YEAR(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH))
    """, emp_id)
    
    if last_stats and last_stats[0]:
        l_total = frappe.utils.flt(last_stats[0][0])
        l_defect = frappe.utils.flt(last_stats[0][1])
        month_num = last_stats[0][2]
        response["last_month_name"] = f"{month_num}月"
        
        if l_total > 0:
            response["last_rate"] = (l_defect / l_total) * 100.0

frappe.response["message"] = response

name: FWB Month Total Sync
script:
# FWB Month Total & Defect Rate Sync
# 类型：文档类型事件
# 参考文档类型：FWB Work Report
# 事件：保存后（可以是通用保存后，或“保存后（已提交文档）”）

# 只在以下条件同时满足时才执行主逻辑：
# 1）单据状态是 已提交(1) 或 已取消(2)
# 2）有员工、有报工日期
if doc.docstatus in (1, 2) and doc.employee and doc.report_date:

    # 1. 取出员工和报工日期对应的年月（注意：按报工单的 report_date 来归属月份）
    report_date = frappe.utils.getdate(doc.report_date)
    employee = doc.employee
    month = report_date.month
    year = report_date.year

    # 2. 查出这个员工在“该月份”的所有【已提交】报工单
    rows = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT 
            name,
            IFNULL(total_amount, 0) AS total_amount,
            IFNULL(qty, 0) AS qty,
            IFNULL(defect_qty, 0) AS defect_qty
        FROM `tabFWB Work Report`
        WHERE 
            employee = %s
            AND docstatus = 1
            AND MONTH(report_date) = %s
            AND YEAR(report_date) = %s
    """, (employee, month, year), as_dict=True)

    # 如果当月一个已提交报工都没有，就什么都不做
    if rows:

        # 3. 计算当月总金额 & 当月次品率
        month_total = 0.0
        total_qty = 0.0
        total_defect = 0.0

        for r in rows:
            month_total += frappe.utils.flt(r.total_amount)
            total_qty += frappe.utils.flt(r.qty)
            total_defect += frappe.utils.flt(r.defect_qty)

        cur_rate = 0.0
        if total_qty > 0:
            cur_rate = (total_defect / total_qty) * 100.0

        # 4. 把“当月总金额”和“本月次品率”写回该员工本月所有报工单
        for r in rows:
            frappe.db.set_value(
                "FWB Work Report",
                r.name,
                "month_total_amount",
                month_total,
                update_modified=False
            )
            frappe.db.set_value(
                "FWB Work Report",
                r.name,
                "month_defect_rate",
                cur_rate,
                update_modified=False
            )

name: FWB Packing Packed Total Sync
script:
# FWB Packing Packed Total Sync (On Submit)
# 类型：文档类型事件
# 参考文档类型：FWB Packing Record
# 事件：提交后

# 只处理有工单号的记录
if not doc.work_order:
    # 没有工单，没法汇总，直接跳过
    pass
else:
    work_order = doc.work_order

    # 1. 计算该工单当前所有“已提交”打包记录的总箱数
    data = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT IFNULL(SUM(carton_count), 0)
        FROM `tabFWB Packing Record`
        WHERE work_order = %s AND docstatus = 1
    """, work_order)

    total_packed = frappe.utils.flt(data[0][0]) if data else 0.0

    # 2. 把这个总箱数写回该工单下所有打包单的 packed_total 字段
    #    （包括草稿和已提交，取消的可以不管）
    rows = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT name
        FROM `tabFWB Packing Record`
        WHERE work_order = %s AND docstatus IN (0, 1)
    """, work_order, as_dict=True)

    for r in rows:
        frappe.db.set_value(
            "FWB Packing Record",
            r.name,
            "packed_total",
            total_packed,
            update_modified=False
        )

name: get_qc_workstations
script:
# 脚本名称: get_qc_workstations
# 脚本类型: API
# 作用：根据工单号，返回该工单在 FWB Work Report 里已经报过工的工作站列表

work_order = frappe.form_dict.get("work_order")

response = {
    "workstations": []
}

if work_order:
    rows = frappe.db.sql(
        """
        SELECT DISTINCT workstation
        FROM `tabFWB Work Report`
        WHERE work_order = %s
          AND docstatus = 1
          AND IFNULL(workstation, '') != ''
        """,
        (work_order,)
    )
    response["workstations"] = [r[0] for r in rows]

frappe.response["message"] = response

name: get_qc_employees
script:
# 脚本名称: get_qc_employees
# 脚本类型: API
# 作用：根据 工单 + 工作站 ，返回在该工单/工作站下报过工的员工列表

work_order = frappe.form_dict.get("work_order")
workstation = frappe.form_dict.get("workstation")

response = {
    "employees": []
}

if work_order and workstation:
    rows = frappe.db.sql(
        """
        SELECT DISTINCT
            wr.employee AS name,
            COALESCE(e.employee_name, wr.employee_name_display, wr.employee) AS employee_name
        FROM `tabFWB Work Report` wr
        LEFT JOIN `tabEmployee` e
            ON e.name = wr.employee
        WHERE
            wr.work_order = %s
            AND wr.workstation = %s
            AND wr.docstatus = 1
            AND IFNULL(wr.employee, '') != ''
        """,
        (work_order, workstation),
        as_dict=True
    )
    response["employees"] = rows

frappe.response["message"] = response

script:
# Script Type: DocType Event

# Event: Before Insert
#
# 作用：
# - 在新建物料（包括“数据导入”）时，

    "纪念币、微章、会员卡盒": "FIN-.YY.###",
    "茶叶盒": "FIN-.YY.###",
    "虫草、燕窝盒": "FIN-.YY.###",
    "西洋参、山参、鹿茸、林蛙油、孢子粉、蒙山全蝎盒": "FIN-.YY.###",
    "酒盒": "FIN-.YY.###",
